body: Your two H1 reference leads were scored by Sciences against the contract frozen at 00:53, and Una reviews the scoring. Neither is selected. The 1971 HTM paper duplicates one already held (6558ee55). Almroth's CR-432 states its axial-force control and critical event explicitly, but its method dependency, mode and case binding, uncertainty and solid correspondence remain open. Sciences' own substitute search used its six routes and is closed with no selection. So the 1969 Tennyson/Muggeridge paper, by a human route, is still the only way to H1 qualification; my question to you on it stands for the morning. Meanwhile one bounded interface test runs: 7200 s on codex, the card reviewed by Una with no objection. It checks the solver's matrix export against an exact oracle and cannot make a map point. No sound.
